research_question: Can bounded source consequences trigger actual new persistent numerical relation-feature allocation, identifying previously unknown nonrectangular cross-factor support sets, and survive new opaque identities, domain interference and out-of-family interactions? Compare against a truly exact equal-information symbolic version-space solver, optimized passive and fixed prior controls.
hypothesis: The candidate's mismatch-triggered new relationship features can explain a hidden arbitrary left-support×right-support factor interaction after <=32 adaptively selected consequences, with no confident wrong in its own source family, and transfer on novel opaque identities; exact symbolic may tie, proving no unique numerical superiority.
representation_caveat: Generic two-factor conjunction with unknown arbitrary 8-position support masks and nonzero three-bit delta is a PROVIDED general compositional family. The correct masks, delta and 64 outcomes are not supplied. Dynamically allocated masks represent newly identified relationships relative to the starting baseline, not invention of an entirely unprovided mathematical primitive.

protocol.candidate: Initially only known baseline. At the first source contradiction, allocate 17 signed-int32 slots: eight unknown left-support membership bits, eight unknown right-support membership bits, three-bit nonzero residual effect stored in an int32. Use direct consequence updates, no gradient, and explicit ABSTAIN while support values remain unidentifiable; never confidently guess a missing relation.
protocol.intervention: Before witness, enumerate a deterministic public 8x8 Latin-square schedule; after first nonzero residual, query each unobserved witness row/column cell until support bits are identified; every query counts, 32 unique actions per fit law, no oracle-based witness selection.
protocol.control_STRONG_SYMBOLIC_MATCHED: Independent exact finite version-space over ALL 8-bit subset supports of cardinality 3..6 per axis and each delta 1..7, implemented with bitset intersections and honest unanimity/abstention. This control sees precisely candidate's actions and consequence receipts. It may infer more than candidate and must not be weakened.
protocol.control_STRONG_SYMBOLIC_PASSIVE: Exact same strong version-space solver, but 32 independently seeded random distinct paid action choices per world, no outcome-based policy.
protocol.control_FIXED_BASE: Unchanged baseline a XOR b, 32 charged candidate actions but no adaptation; report confidently wrong results.
protocol.control_NO_UPDATE: No source learning, all held abstain.
protocol.control_FITTED_CONVENTIONAL: Not run in this source-only feasibility screen; fully trained matched conventional model required before original first-use.
protocol.source_and_scoring: Source owner enforces legal distinct fit IDs, 32 call cap, no transfer/negative first-use or repeated aggregate scoring, matched transcript receipts for same-action arms. Candidate and symbolic code cannot import hidden-law source.
protocol.retention: Restore all 128 memories from source-blind event ledger; checksum mismatch and digest-repaired forged feature slots must fail; earlier law predictions unchanged after later laws
protocol.efficiency: Record allocated int32 feature slots only, source/eval timing separately if measured. A whole-process >=2x speed or energy claim is prohibited without separately matched repeated independent benchmark.
